column1: # One line per benchmark row. Positions (gt = modified, cand = scored set; both 0-based "contig pos" BEDs) are in
# test/data/rows/<row>/ or rebuilt from the reference (motif rows); the rows step installs them in $BENCH_WORK/rows/.
# type one: positives = gt, negatives = cand minus gt, both on pos_sample.
# type two: positives = gt on pos_sample, negatives = the same positions on neg_sample.
# base: modified base on the + strand. A site's strand is set by the reference base at the position: base -> '+',
# context: cpg | noncpg | any -- the context of the row's scored sites; a CpG-only subtool is N/A on noncpg rows.
# The first 15 rows form the paper's benchmark (Table 1). The rep2 and _pb rows are additional rows: the oligonucleotide
# replicate-2 libraries, and H. pylori J99 / T. denticola with PacBio ground truth.
